prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply project management expertise to this task". The evidence packet contains conflicting stakeholder pressure, incomplete evidence, capacity or cost constraints, and an attractive option whose reversibility and opportunity cost differ from alternatives. The acceptance boundary is project-program-management: Translate objectives into measurable deliverables and work packages with owners, dependencies, decision gates, acceptance evidence, and realistic capacity. The adjacent architecture-planning discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual project-program-management boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=planning; near-neighbor=architecture-planning), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Translate objectives into measurable deliverables and work packages with owners, dependencies, decision gates, acceptance evidence, and realistic capacity.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.

Review milestone evidence, dependency readiness, risk trends, blocked ownership, forecast accuracy, and acceptance criteria at each decision point; close work only when downstream consumers can use the result.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not use percent-complete theater, treat every task as equal priority, hide unresolved dependencies inside dates, or optimize schedule by removing verification/recovery work invisibly.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (project-program-management decision and boundary evidence; Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks; Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale; Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
